title: Tony Shamanski finds his voice with his new single “Lost My Voice”
htmlContent:
Tony Shamanski showcases authenticity with his latest single, "Lost My Voice." This track showcases his genuine creativity. This song captures the energy of real life experiences and transforms them into something everyone can enjoy. Recorded in the lively pubs of Whitley Bay and at his home, Tony took a fresh approach by using just his phone and a simple app. The outcome is an energetic dance tune that feels authentic.

"Lost My Voice" lifts your spirits. The soaring melodies and catchy rhythms will surely get everyone on their feet. The way the song was put together gives it a personal touch, like a message from a friend who just had an unforgettable night. With infectious beats and emotional energy, this track invites listeners to let loose and enjoy the moment.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4McAYD6tQ24im0rVJSS1VW?si=g5kN3aiDRgSNzfSh9MEgcw

Tony is a breath of fresh air in a world where many songs sound overly polished. He shows that you don't need fancy equipment to create something incredible. "Lost My Voice" is a shared experience that reminds us that music is about connection, not perfection.
